I've just called to find out if my appointment today is face to face or phone. Only to be told it's at a surgery in Cowley...when I live one road away from WLMC. This has happened because my doctor has moved to the other surgery. I have lived next to the surgery for 24 years and now they expect me to take a bus. If I had not called, I would have missed my appointment going to the wrong place! Before leaving, I checked Google reviews and found the other surgery to be unfavourable. I have now asked for a new doctor and appt at WLMC, which they were happy to do.

This was all a little frustrating. If they had warned me in advance, I could have reacted without having to lose today's slot. Im still happy with my doctors, just frustrated by the massive admin error, consequently I'm not adjusting their rating.

Previous: I've just had my holiday jabs here. The check- in process is straight forward and quick.

As my local surgery, I find that I'm actually able to see them face to face within 10 days of making an appointment.

There can be a wait to see staff, even when you arrive on time. However, this is no different from elsewhere.

The reception staff are pleasant and
